verdict.reason: Verified independently: packages/frontend/src/debug/ contains only locate-surface.ts, locate-surface.test.ts, mount.tsx, surface-registry.ts, route.ts, route.test.ts, and locators/{sheet,doc}.{ts,test.ts} — no handover.ts, panel.tsx, or host.ts. The task file docs/tasks/active/20260821-debug-report-todo.md lines 146-151 explicitly checks off `src/debug/handover.ts`, `src/debug/panel.tsx`, and `src/debug/host.ts` as landed PR-2 deliverables. The actual files with matching content live at packages/debug-report/src/ui/handover.ts, packages/debug-report/src/ui/panel.tsx, and packages/debug-report/src/ui/host.ts (confirmed by reading packages/debug-report/src/ui/host.ts, which implements exactly what the checklist item describes — 'the dev HostAdapter' via createDevHost — while packages/debug-report/src/host.ts, a different file, holds only the bare interface as described in the PR-1a section). The same doc also mis-cites `packages/frontend/src/debug/overlay.test.tsx` at line 127, when that file is actually packages/debug-report/src/ui/overlay.test.tsx — reinforcing that the path convention used in this section is stale/incorrect. This is a task-narration file under docs/tasks/, squarely in the Docs lane, and the mismatch is exactly the 'documentation contradicted by this PR's own code' category (file paths the prose claims do not match where the code actually lives), which the rubric treats as major. No guard elsewhere neutralizes this, and the code is genuinely absent from the claimed path, so there is no valid refutation ground.
